About the job

Job Title: QA Lead (with Automation Expertise) Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Reports To:Delivery Manager Role OverviewThe QA Manager will lead the Quality Assurance team to ensure the delivery of high-quality software products. This role emphasizes test automation strategy and implementation, while managing manual testing efforts where necessary. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, deep knowledge of QA methodologies, and hands-on experience with automation frameworks.Key Responsibilities       Leadership & Strategy      Define and implement QA strategy, standards, and best practices across projects.Manage and mentor QA engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.Collaborate with Product, Development, and DevOps teams to align QA processes with business goals.

Automation      Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web, API, and mobile applications.Drive automation coverage for regression, smoke, and performance testing.Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous delivery.

Quality Assurance      Oversee test planning, execution, and reporting for functional, integration, and system testing.Ensure defect tracking and root cause analysis are performed effectively.Establish metrics and KPIs to measure quality and team performance.

Tools & Technologies      Hands-on experience with tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, JMeter, and API testing tools (Postman, RestAssured).Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).Knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.

Qualifications      Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.8+ years of QA experience, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.Proven expertise in test automation frameworks and scripting languages (Java, Python, JavaScript).Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills      Experience with Shift-Left Testing and early QA involvement in SDLC.Knowledge of performance testing and security testing practices.Familiarity with AI-based testing tools and automation accelerators

Desired Skills and Experience

Automation, DevOps, leadership, Governance, Product Management, Regulatory Compliance, Test Planning, Root Cause Analysis, Qu

personal_details.label: Senior SDET | API & UI Automation | Java · Python · Microservices
personal_details.summary: Senior SDET with 6 years scaling API and UI automation across airline, quick-commerce, and OTT microservice domains. Architected 1000+ test case suites using REST Assured, TestNG, and Cucumber BDD; reduced QA overhead by 12 hrs/week through AI-assisted automation (AiDE). Experienced in shift-left testing, CI/CD integration, and observability-driven quality across distributed systems.

achievements: Drove shift-left testing practices using Azure DevOps and BDD Cucumber, reducing bug leakage to production across 3 airline microservice domains.
PNR Linking & SSR [REST Assured · ReadyAPI · BDD · AiDE] : Architected automation frameworks for airline domain; built 1000+ test cases cutting effort from 750 to 50 man-hours (93% reduction).
Order Bags [REST Assured · AiDE · E2E] : Leveraged Agentic AI (AiDE) to accelerate framework implementation by 50% and reduce test drafting time by 75% across service-level and E2E validations.
Automated Kibana log analysis, issue reporting, and data quality validation pipelines; eliminated manual intervention and saved 12 hrs/week of QA overhead.
Automated end-to-end API flows and DB validations using the Ekam Java Framework for 4 key features, achieving 60% test coverage in a microservices-based Merchant Service suite.
Owned full SDLC feature testing : planning through deployment ensuring minimal production bug leakage via Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
Led observability-driven root cause analysis of daily stability failures using Allure reports, Google Metrics Explorer, and Kibana across GCP-hosted services.
Designed a BDD automation framework using Python, Appium, and TestRail API; automated ~50% of sanity suite, saving ~5 man-days/month.
Performed domain API, stability, and KPI testing for Web and iOS platforms using Charles Proxy, Postman, and Burp Suite.
Contributed to a ₹100Cr OTT app under Agile SDLC; directly improved iOS App Store rating from 1.9 → 3.5 through systematic API and stability testing.
